title: Saving Data in Connected Scenario
description: Learn CRUD operations in connected scenario with automatic EntityState management.

data.text: In the **connected scenario**, the same instance of DbContext is used for retrieving and saving entities. EF Core automatically sets the appropriate EntityState whenever an entity is created, modified, or deleted.
